assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
The service is supported by diagnosis codes I49.5 and I48.0.
The clinical indication note confirms that the monitoring is necessary to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
